name: Andor & Rogue One
description: Manifestos, last words, and hard-won defiance from Andor and Rogue One — the Rebellion before it had a hero.
author: Quips Editorial

quotes.content: We have hope. Rebellions are built on hope!
quotes.source: Rogue One: A Star Wars Story (2016)
quotes.notes: Jyn's answer to a Rebel Alliance council that would rather surrender than raid Scarif; the line also served as the film's tagline.

quotes.content: This is a rebellion, isn't it? I rebel!
quotes.source: Rogue One: A Star Wars Story (2016)
quotes.notes: Jyn's retort when she is told her plan has no sanction from Alliance command.

quotes.content: What chance do we have? The question is what choice? Run? Hide? Plead for mercy? Scatter your forces? You give way to an enemy this evil with this much power and you condemn the galaxy to an eternity of submission. The time to fight is now!
quotes.source: Rogue One: A Star Wars Story (2016)
quotes.notes: Jyn addresses the Alliance council on Yavin 4 after Senator Pamlo asks what chance they have against the Death Star.

quotes.content: Some of us — most of us — we've all done terrible things on behalf of the rebellion. Spies. Saboteurs. Assassins. Everything I did, I did for the Rebellion. Every time I walked away from something I wanted to forget, I told myself it was for a cause that I believed in. A cause that was worth it. Without that, we've lost. Everything we've done would've been for nothing. I couldn't face myself if I gave up now. None of us could.
quotes.source: Rogue One: A Star Wars Story (2016)
quotes.notes: Cassian's confession to Jyn about the cost of intelligence work, and the film's clearest statement of what the Rebellion asks of the people inside it.

quotes.content: I'm one with the Force. The Force is with me.
quotes.source: Rogue One: A Star Wars Story (2016)
quotes.notes: The Guardian of the Whills' mantra, chanted throughout the film and most famously as he walks unarmed through crossfire on Scarif.

quotes.content: The strongest stars have hearts of kyber.
quotes.source: Rogue One: A Star Wars Story (2016)
quotes.notes: Chirrut to Jyn, about the kyber crystal pendant her mother left her — the same crystal the Empire mines to power the Death Star.

quotes.content: Let them pass in peace.
quotes.source: Rogue One: A Star Wars Story (2016)
quotes.notes: Chirrut's blessing, offered to strangers in the streets of Jedha City.

quotes.content: Congratulations. You're being rescued. Please do not resist.
quotes.source: Rogue One: A Star Wars Story (2016)
quotes.notes: The reprogrammed Imperial security droid's introduction to Jyn, delivered immediately after he slams her to the ground.

quotes.content: Jyn, I'll be there for you. Cassian said I had to.
quotes.source: Rogue One: A Star Wars Story (2016)
quotes.notes: K-2SO volunteers for the Scarif raid, then undercuts himself; Jyn's reply is simply 'Charming.'

quotes.content: I find that answer vague and unconvincing.
quotes.source: Rogue One: A Star Wars Story (2016)
quotes.notes: K-2SO's standing verdict on human explanations, and one of the droid's most-quoted lines.

quotes.content: Save the Rebellion. Save the dream.
quotes.source: Rogue One: A Star Wars Story (2016)
quotes.notes: The dying partisan's last words as Jedha City is destroyed; also used as a tagline for the film.

quotes.content: You're confusing peace... with terror.
quotes.source: Rogue One: A Star Wars Story (2016)
quotes.notes: Galen to Director Krennic in the opening scene on Lah'mu, refusing to return to the Death Star project.

quotes.content: So I did the one thing that nobody expected: I lied. I learned to lie. I played the part of a beaten man resigned to the sanctuary of his work. I made myself indispensable, and all the while I laid the groundwork of my revenge.
quotes.source: Rogue One: A Star Wars Story (2016)
quotes.notes: From Galen's holographic message to Jyn, explaining the fifteen years he spent inside the Empire building his own sabotage.

quotes.content: I've placed a weakness deep within the system. A flaw so small and powerful, they will never find it.
quotes.source: Rogue One: A Star Wars Story (2016)
quotes.notes: The revelation in Galen's hologram that the Death Star's exhaust-port vulnerability was designed in on purpose.

quotes.content: We were on the verge of greatness. We were this close to providing peace and security for the galaxy.
quotes.source: Rogue One: A Star Wars Story (2016)
quotes.notes: Krennic's pitch to Galen Erso on Lah'mu, moments before Galen answers that he is confusing peace with terror.

quotes.content: "When" has become "now", Director Krennic. The Emperor will tolerate no further delay.
quotes.source: Rogue One: A Star Wars Story (2016)
quotes.notes: Tarkin pressures Krennic aboard the Executrix; the character was recreated digitally, with Guy Henry performing the role originated by Peter Cushing.

quotes.content: Be careful not to choke on your aspirations, Director.
quotes.source: Rogue One: A Star Wars Story (2016)
quotes.notes: Vader's warning to Krennic at Fortress Vader on Mustafar, delivered mid-Force-choke.

quotes.content: Hope.
quotes.source: Rogue One: A Star Wars Story (2016)
quotes.notes: The final line of the film, as Leia is handed the stolen Death Star plans; the digital Leia was performed by Ingvild Deila.

quotes.content: That someone like me would ever get inside their house, walk their floors, spit in their food, take their gear.
quotes.notes: Cassian explains to Luthen Rael why stealing from the Empire is easy: it cannot imagine being robbed by the people it ignores.

quotes.content: Security is an illusion. You want security? Call the Navy. Launch a regiment of troopers. We are healthcare providers. We treat sickness. We identify symptoms. We locate germs whether they arise from within or have come from the outside. The longer we wait to identify a disorder, the harder it is to treat the disease.
quotes.notes: Partagaz corrects a subordinate who has recited the ISB mission statement verbatim, defining the Imperial Security Bureau as an immune system rather than a police force.

quotes.content: My name is Kino Loy. I'm the day shift manager on Level Five. I'm speaking to you from the command center on Level Eight. We are, at this moment, in control of the facility. How long we hang on, how far we get, how many of us make it out, all of that is now up to us. Wherever you are right now, get up, stop the work. Get out of your cells, take charge and start climbing. They don't have enough guards and they know it. We will never have a better chance than this, and I would rather die trying to take them down than giving them what they want. There is one way out. There are 5,000 of us. If we can fight half as hard as we've been working, we will be home in no time. One way out!
quotes.notes: The floor manager who spent the series counseling compliance takes the prison's public address system and calls the Narkina 5 uprising; the line about dying rather than yielding is Cassian's, which Kino quotes back to the block.

quotes.content: I can't swim.
quotes.notes: Kino's last words, spoken at the edge of the escape as the other prisoners jump; he leads a breakout he cannot personally survive.

quotes.content: Calm. Kindness. Kinship. Love. I've given up all chance at inner peace. I've made my mind a sunless space. I share my dreams with ghosts. I wake up every day to an equation I wrote 15 years ago from which there's only one conclusion: I'm damned for what I do. My anger, my ego, my unwillingness to yield, my eagerness to fight, they've set me on a path from which there is no escape. I yearned to be a savior against injustice without contemplating the cost, and by the time I looked down there was no longer any ground beneath my feet. What is my sacrifice? I'm condemned to use the tools of my enemy to defeat them. I burn my decency for someone else's future. I burn my life to make a sunrise that I know I'll never see. And the ego that started this fight will never have a mirror or an audience or the light of gratitude. So what do I sacrifice? Everything!
quotes.notes: Luthen's answer when his ISB mole Lonni Jung asks what the spymaster himself gives up; the speech is the series' definitive statement of the price of clandestine rebellion.

quotes.content: There will be times when the struggle seems impossible. I know this already. Alone, unsure, dwarfed by the scale of the enemy. Remember this. Freedom is a pure idea. It occurs spontaneously and without instruction. Random acts of insurrection are occurring constantly throughout the galaxy. There are whole armies, battalions that have no idea that they've already enlisted in the cause. Remember that the frontier of the Rebellion is everywhere. And even the smallest act of insurrection pushes our lines forward. And then remember this. The Imperial need for control is so desperate because it is so unnatural. Tyranny requires constant effort. It breaks, it leaks. Authority is brittle. Oppression is the mask of fear. Remember that. And know this, the day will come when all these skirmishes and battles, these moments of defiance will have flooded the banks of the Empire's authority and then there will be one too many. One single thing will break the siege. Remember this. Try.
quotes.notes: Nemik's manifesto, recorded before the Aldhani raid and played back by Cassian after his death; by the end of the series the recording has spread widely enough that the ISB cannot contain it.

quotes.content: There is a wound that won't heal at the center of the galaxy. There is a darkness reaching like rust into everything around us. We let it grow, and now it's here. It's here, and it's not visiting anymore. It wants to stay. The Empire is a disease that thrives in darkness, it is never more alive than when we sleep. It's easy for the dead to tell you to fight, and maybe it's true, maybe fighting is useless. Perhaps it's too late. But I'll tell you this. If I could do it again, I'd wake up early and be fighting these bastards from the start. Fight the Empire!
quotes.notes: Maarva's posthumous eulogy for herself, played as a hologram at her funeral on Rix Road; the Imperial attempt to cut it off touches off the riot that ends the season.

quotes.content: Tell him, none of this is his fault. It was already burning. He's just the first spark of the fire. Tell him, he knows everything he needs to know and feels everything he needs to feel. And when the day comes, and those two pull together, he will be an unstoppable force for good. Tell him... I love him more than anything he could ever do wrong.
quotes.notes: Brasso recites Maarva's parting message to Cassian word for word, having been given it to hold until Cassian returned to Ferrix.

quotes.content: Kill me. Or take me in.
quotes.notes: Cassian confronts Luthen aboard his haulcraft at the end of the first season, offering himself to the Rebellion without conditions.

quotes.content: You made this decision long ago. The Empire cannot win. You'll never feel right unless you're doing what you can to stop them. You're coming home to yourself. You've become more than your fear. Let that protect you.
quotes.notes: Cassian steadies Niya, an Imperial technician about to betray her own facility, as she asks whether dying for it would be worth it.

quotes.content: Joy has no wind at its back. Joy will not announce its arrival. You need to listen for it, and be mindful of how fleeting and delicate it can be.
quotes.notes: From Perrin's toast at his daughter Leida's pre-wedding dinner, where Chandrilan custom obliges the father of the bride to offer a single truthful insight.

quotes.content: All doubts aside, there is one glaring certainty. If we do not stand together, we will be crushed.
quotes.notes: Mon Mothma canvassing the few senators who will still hear her out on a motion against the Public Order Resentencing Directive.

quotes.content: You think I'm crazy? Yes, I am. Revolution is not for the sane. Look at us. Unloved, hunted, cannon fodder, we'll all be dead before the Republic is back, and yet... here we are.
quotes.notes: Saw, deliberately breathing rhydonium fumes, explains to a young Wilmon Paak what kind of person keeps fighting a war he will not live to see won.

quotes.content: She was a warrior. She was everything that you have daydreamed about. She was a blooded, fearless warrior whose loss will be mourned in ways that you will never understand.
quotes.notes: Vel's fury at the recruit whose carelessness killed Cinta Kaz during the Ghorman weapons handoff.

quotes.content: I believe we are in crisis. The distance between what is said and what is known to be true has become an abyss. Of all the things at risk, the loss of an objective reality is perhaps the most dangerous. The death of truth is the ultimate victory of evil. When truth leaves us, when we let it slip away, when it is ripped from our hands, we become vulnerable to the appetite of whatever monster screams the loudest.
quotes.notes: The heart of Mon Mothma's privilege speech to the Imperial Senate the morning after the Ghorman massacre, given on time yielded to her by Bail Organa.

quotes.content: What took place yesterday, what happened yesterday on Ghorman, was unprovoked genocide! Yes, genocide! And that truth has been exiled from this Chamber! And the monster screaming the loudest, the monster we helped create, the monster who will come for us all soon enough, is Emperor Palpatine!
quotes.notes: The close of the same speech, and the moment Mon Mothma stops working inside the Senate and flees Coruscant for open rebellion.

quotes.content: I'm choosing for the both of us. I'm choosing the Rebellion. And when it's done, when it's over and we've won, we can do all the things we ever wanted. Everything we'd know we've missed. I'll find you.
quotes.notes: Bix's recorded farewell to Cassian, left behind because she believes her presence is the one thing that could pull him out of the fight.

quotes.content: And you're too late. The Rebellion isn't here anymore. It's flown away. It's everywhere now. There's a whole galaxy out there waiting to disgust you.
quotes.notes: Luthen to Dedra Meero when she finally corners him in his antiquities gallery, moments before he takes his own life rather than be questioned.

quotes.content: We fight to win. That means we lose. And lose and lose and lose... until we're ready. All you know now is how much you hate. You bank that. You hide that. You keep it alive until you know what to do with it.
quotes.notes: In flashback, Luthen teaches a young Kleya Marki the discipline of the long game after they witness a public execution.

quotes.content: You don't want freedom. You want chaos, chaos for everyone but you.
quotes.notes: Dedra's verdict on Luthen at the moment of his capture, in the confrontation the ISB supervisor had spent years imagining.

quotes.content: If I die fighting the Empire... I want to go down swinging.
quotes.notes: Bail Organa's reason for authorizing the mission that will lead Cassian to Galen Erso and, in turn, to Rogue One.
